profile.name: Ivo Bubeňko, Ing.
profile.role: Software Developer focused on AWS, Web Development, CI/CD and Secure Digital Systems
profile.summary: Informatics graduate from FEI TUKE with enterprise SAP ABAP experience and hands-on AWS, CI/CD, serverless backend and frontend project work.

paragraphs: I am an Informatics graduate from the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics, Technical University of Košice. My background includes full-time work as a Junior SAP ABAP Developer, along with hands-on experience in modern web and cloud technologies through practical projects, continuous learning and real-world development work.

My profile combines enterprise software development with practical work in AWS, CI/CD, serverless applications and frontend development. I focus on reliable software, automated deployments and secure digital systems, including verifiable QR code workflows based on digital signatures.
focusAreas: secure QR code verification and digital signatures

projects.title: AsphalesQR - Securing QR Code Integrity
projects.description: Diploma thesis project focused on verifying the integrity and authenticity of QR code content using digital signatures.
projects.outcome: Explores verifiable QR codes, browser-based verification, secure scanning workflows and practical deployment of QR content authenticity checks.

details: Developed and maintained test services based on tester specifications.
Worked on improving functional and performance reliability of software.
Analyzed and debugged software errors, identified root causes and proposed optimized fixes.
Contributed to process development and optimization with focus on efficiency, scalability and integration into existing systems.
Implemented a GitLab CI/CD deployment pipeline for a Svelte frontend across multiple development environments.
Used separate S3 buckets and CloudFront distributions per environment for clean isolation and repeatable releases.
Automated CloudFront cache invalidation through AWS CLI so users received fresh frontend assets after deployment.
Developed and maintained Svelte frontend functionality based on evolving requirements.
Contributed to an AWS SAM serverless backend in Node.js, updated Lambda handlers integrated with Amazon RDS and implemented a dedicated authorization Lambda.
